{{Quote|It was a suicide mission, a mission doomed to failure. Just the kind of mission Luke loves to take on.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
The '''Battle of Hanoon''' was a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Krantian Civil War]] which resulted in the complete destruction of the ancient and powerful [[Jedi artifact/Legends|artifact]] [[Vor'Na'Tu]] and the liberation of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Hanoon]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I can't explain it, but somehow Princess Leia was contacted by Echuu Shen-Jon!|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] after his shattering of the ancient and powerful [[Jedi artifact/Legends|artifact]] [[Vor'Na'Tu]] and his [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Hanoon|Geddes]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]] contacted [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and warned her about the potential power of the shards. During those years, the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] had been [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] and colonized as Hanoon, and the colonists had found the shards and held them as valuable relics in their [[City/Legends|cities]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Yittreas]] had also fled the [[Krantian Civil War]] to Geddes and fortified the asteroid. Organa and her brother, the future founder of the [[New Jedi Order]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] ventured to Hanoon to find the shards<ref name="SW:GB" /> in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==The battle==
===Recovering the shards===
{{Quote|Should the Empire discover the shards, the power could still be tapped somehow.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[File:Magentic.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Fortress at Magentic.]]
A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] task force led by Organa and Skywalker returned to the asteroid to retrieve the shards. The two led 9 [[New Republic soldier/Legends|troopers]], one [[Mobile Proton Torpedo Launcher]], and one [[Blaster Cannon]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
The force visited the two of [[Reticul]] first, where the inhabitants agreed to turn over their shard if the Imperial [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser turrets]] surrounding the town were destroyed. The Republic forces deployed the Blaster Cannon to eliminate the turrets, and Reticul gratefully turned over their shard and several [[R2-D5]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]], which the Republic army used to establish their own base, including a [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to hold the shards. The strike force also eliminated the nearby Imperial base.<ref name="SW:GB" />
{{Endgame}}

The strike force also visited [[Libreck]], where a leader of the [[Hanoon Imperial Resistance]], [[Excellency]] [[Lathe Parthenian]], was held. Libreck turned over its shard after Parthenian was freed and the stormtrooper [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was eliminated. [[Magentic]] turned over their shard after the Rebublic strike force destroyed the [[Fortress/Legends|Fortress]] guarding the town. [[Reeche]] demanded and received a tribute of 500 units of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] and 500 units of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] in exchange for their shard. Skywalker returned the four shards to the Temple for storage.<ref name="SW:GB" />

===Capturing the Terraform Processor===
{{Quote|The Hanoon needed to control their own world, and in order to do that, they needed to control the Terraform Processor.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_New_Geddes.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Imperial forces on Hanoon.]]
Skywalker and Organa then decided to stay and liberate the asteroid world, although it was considered a suicide mission. They gathered a Blaster Cannon, two Heavy [[Rebel attack tank|Attack Tanks]], a [[Mobile Proton Torpedo Launcher|Heavy Torpedo Launcher]], nine Repeater Troopers, and a [[Transport Ship (Rebel Alliance)|Transport Ship]] filled with five labor droids. They advanced on [[New Geddes]], the city which sprang up from the old research facility, intent on capturing the [[Terraform Processor]]. The Blaster Cannon advanced ahead of forces and eliminated four turrets to protect the Transport Ship, which was boxed in the [[Water/Legends|canal]]. The forces of New Geddes, veterans who originally served on [[Krant]], resisted ferociously, but the Republic strike force infiltrated the base. The labor droids took control of the Terraform Processor.<ref name="SW:GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
The strike force built up their defenses to maintain control of the Processor and recruited additional forces for the push deeper into New Geddes. The army fought past the Imperial's defenses, including [[air defense tower]]s. They destroyed one Fortress, but Moff Yittreas escaped to another. They eventually cornered him and his forces in another Fortress, and defeated them.<ref name="SW:GB" />
{{Endgame}}

The survivors tried breaking into the Jedi Temple to take control of the shards. Skywalker, sensing the disturbance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], returned to the Temple and obliterated the remains of the Vor'Na'Tu, scattering its dust into the solar winds.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I sense a disturbance in the Force.|Skywalker before obliterating the Vor'Na'Tu shards|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[File:Yittreas_fortresses_destroyed.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Yittreas]]'s [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] is destroyed.]]
After the battle, Hanoon joined the New Republic. Shen-Jon's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] never again contacted Organa.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Hanoon was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] to the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. It appeared during two consecutive Princess Leia campaign missions. The missions and thus the battle were also included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].

This article assumes the players went to Reticul first during the first mission, as it is closest, and uses the Blaster Cannon to knock out the turrets, as the strategy guide suggests. The player may create any structure in the base, but must build a Jedi Temple to hold the four shards after recovering them from Reticul, Magentic, Libreck, and Reeche. The objectives may be completed in any order. The optional objective is to destroy the Imperial base in the mission. This article assumes the player did so. For the second mission, the player may build up any army forces as long as the Imperial base is destroyed and the Terraform Processor is protected.

There is a discrepancy in the dates of the battle. Yittreas' ''Galactic Battlegrounds'' DataBank entry states the Krantian Civil War lasted 10 years, but this was superseded by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which lists the battle as taking place in 6 ABY. This article follows the later source. The [[2005]] book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', furthermore, places the start of the Civil War around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
